title: 第6章
content_zh:
宋娟像现在才发现这个问题似的说：哎呀这个事儿我还真没想到，也是你比璐璐胖不少，估计是穿不了的，那一会儿我拿回去看看我同事家的姑娘能穿不。
把地上的衣服迅速的又包了起来，看李巍也吃得差不多了，就让李巍帮着她拿回家去，李巍和他妈出了门，夏真钰把茶几上的碗盘都收拾了洗干净，把西餐和红酒摆到了餐桌上，放了首钢琴曲，等李巍回来。
李巍回来看见夏真钰布置的情形有些愣神儿，想了想问道：真钰你这是做什么呢？今天是什么特殊的日子吗，怎么不早点说，我刚才吃过饭了。
夏真钰示意李巍坐在自己的对面笑着说：就当陪我吃吧，我还没吃呢，这些是特意去订的，不是什么特殊的日子，只不过我想我们结婚也快一个月了，就是谈恋爱时也没搞过什么浪漫的场面，想想以后还真得偶尔来这么一次才有情趣。
李巍也笑了笑说：是啊，都怪我，总也想不到这些，太木纳了。
二个人在舒缓的音乐中默默的吃着东西，夏真钰终于决定提及二人这些天的问题：李巍，我今天其实是想谈谈我们之间的事，以前总也找不到合适的时间。
还没等夏真钰往下说，李巍已经急忙开口：真钰，我知道，这些日子来冷落了你。我不是有意的，我是觉得自己对不起你。
夏真钰温柔的说：为什么会觉得对不起我？
李巍说：结婚这么长时间，我们还没成为真正的夫妻，我知道是我的原因，压力很大，我也不知道自己是怎么回事，我真怕是我身体有问题，那该怎么办？又怕你会怪我、瞧不起我。
总算是把症结说了出来了，夏真钰认为李巍也是这个原因，主要是男人的自尊问题，既然肯谈就好办，于是说：李巍，我们是夫妻了，有什么困难都要共同面对的，其实我也有压力的，几次不成事弄得我现在也挺害怕的了。
你也害怕？为什么？李巍奇怪夏真钰为什么害怕。
夏真钰无奈的看着李巍：我当然害怕了，你试那么多次我也很疼的，特别难受。
啊，我没想到，是啊，你每次也很痛苦。真钰，要是我们能早些沟通这些日子就不会那么难过了。你给我段时间调试，如果还不行，我、我就去医院看看。李巍下了很大的决心才能说出去医院的话。
夏真钰有些动容说道：好，我们一起克服困难，其实也不一定是生理上有问题，我上网查了点资料，有很多原因是心理上的，你放轻松，千万别认为我会有想法，我只会支持你。要是真去医院，我也会陪着你。
两人谈完话，关系一下子融洽许多，晚上上了床夏真钰和李巍二个人又在被窝里手握着手聊天，一直聊到天微亮了才闭了眼睡了会儿，没几个小时就又起床准备上班，虽然睡眠不足但心情都很好，夏真钰胸口少了块大石头。
刚到单位，王姐就跟了过来，憋着笑对夏真钰说：真钰啊，你是不是得请客了？
看王姐这表情，一定是有什么好事了：王姐，这么高兴，是不是发什么福利了？就是请客也得你请我啊，我能比得过你吗？
傻子，你还不知道呢，等会朱主任就会让你们这些合同工上去签约。
夏真钰摸不着头脑：签约？签什么约，合同还没到期呢啊。
王姐扑哧笑了一声说：你也是个有福气的了，接待了一回周市长还顺带把自己的待遇提了上去。

王姐，你怎么越说我越糊涂了呢，你好好和我说说啊，别总开玩笑。
王姐不再逗她了，说道：前几天内部开会，我替我们科长参加的，要不也不能知道。郭主任说上次周市长视察走后，亲自和区长说你们这些合同工的待遇太低了，应该提高，还说你表现不错。所以区里特别开了专项会议，讨论你们待遇的事儿，最后决定参照正式编制的６０％给你们涨工资呢！你说，你应不应该请客？
这可真是天大的馅饼啊，这待遇提升的可不是一星儿半点儿的啊，一下涨了上千快，而且今后还会跟着正式编浮动，周瑾宇真是个大福星，老天保佑这样的领导官运亨通吧，夏真钰在心里默默祝福周瑾宇。
果然，一会儿科长要她和另上几个合同工上楼找办公室主任，进了朱主任的办公室，朱主任让他们都坐下说道：你们可能已经听说了为什么找你们上来。你们得感谢上级领导对你们的关怀啊，今后要更加努力的工作才不辜负组织上对你们的期望。
大家纷纷点头表决心，朱主任又讲了一会场面话，就让大家把新合同都签了，一签就是三年，每个人都喜气洋洋的。
这时朱主任又开起了玩笑：其实啊，你们最应该感谢的就是小夏啊，要是没有她和周市长说了实话，你们能有今天吗？
夏真钰真是不知道说什么好，她不过是对周瑾宇的问题实话实说罢了，没想到人家领导真办实事儿啊，其他人听了朱主任的话，也都玩笑的和夏真钰道了谢，弄得夏真钰很不好意思。
又闹了儿会，怕打扰朱主任工作就全出来了，朱主任把夏真钰单独留了下来，又给她倒了杯茶，夏真钰受宠若惊，朱主任对待他们这些编外人员可从未这么和气过。
朱主任又坐回办公桌后面，眯着眼和善的对夏真钰说：小夏啊，上次视察你表现不错，上级领导都很满意，对你印象很好。
从进门开始朱主任不断的提起自己那天的表现，夏真钰还真不知道自己好在哪儿了。
朱主任又说：小夏，别看我平时不太和你们交流，但我一直都是非常关心你们的。现在我以老大哥的身份和你说啊，这别人都不知道，要不是后来郭主任让我陪着我也不知道，这可是区长说的。
朱主任想了想接着说：我听区长的意思是，那天本来周市长是很不高兴的，不过后来和电脑演示人员交流后让周市长心情又好了，这才没追究到底的。区长还说周市长夸了那个演示人员几句，然后就提了待遇的事儿。
夏真钰觉得自己这就是走运，不然怎么能得到周瑾宇的夸奖呢，而且那天自己还出了丑。
朱主任的声音又压低了一些：郭主任回来后，觉得你就是咱们单位的福星啊，那天要是周市长真追究事儿就大了，于是想着数字化市政这个项目怎么也是个长期工作，经常要去市里汇报工作的，就想把你现在的工作换一换。
朱主任，谢谢各位领导对我的厚爱，我在哪个工作岗位我都完全服从安排，可是要说我得了周市长的青睐这个就有点牵强了，我怕以后万一……夏真钰觉得自己必须说明白，不然现在都认为自己是福星，难保下次没这么好运就会说自己是灾星了。
不用着急，我明白你的意思，你放心不过就是那么回事儿，谁还能认真呢。给你安排的新工作就是给你换个部门，直接去信息中心工程技术科，也不用做什么，就是做些内勤报表什么的工作，但你一定要尽快了解和熟悉整个项目的情况，以后郭主任做汇报你就跟着。
走出朱主任的办公室，夏真钰都有些飘飘然了，刚才朱主任说了她的新工作后，还说今后除工资外的一切福利待遇都给她参照正式编，她都要高兴死了，自己虽然还是合同工但实际待遇却已经比得上公务员了。
不过她也有些担心，大家都以是自己让周市长开心才逃过一劫的，其实她心里明白哪有可能呢，也许是周瑾宇不愿大开杀戒罢了，要是今后真出什么事儿，自己恐怕又得被打回原型了。
发了一会愁又想开了，怕什么，反正好不好都是上级领导说的，自己又没揽功，最坏不过是６０％的待遇啊，已经好太多了，还是给高梅丽打个电话庆祝下吧。
作者有话要说：光光看到有人

ＰＳ：光光是木有存稿滴，都是码完字直接就发上来的，难免有不当的地方，大家一定要指出来啊。
下一章估计周瑾宇就该和夏真钰有对手戏了，不过不能肯定、不能肯定啊。
☆、再遇周瑾宇
行啊，有你的，夏真钰！这回可是鱼跃龙门了。吃着海鲜自助大餐，高梅丽笑得灿烂，这回真钰总算是熬出头了。
别乱说，我这还是合同制呢。夏真钰话虽这么说，嘴角的笑却怎么也掩饰不住。
得了，你还在我面前装，管他什么编制，只要钱不少就行了。这回你婆婆可要高看你一眼了，你现在赚得可不比他们家李巍少。
结完婚她对我还是不错的，也没什么为难的事情，不过我得抽点时间学做饭就是了。夏真钰就事论事，宋娟对她还行，除了对她还没学会做饭有点想法外，其他还都过得去。
学做饭我是赞同的，这也是应该做的，不过你有时间做吗？五点下班，从走到车站再挤公交车，你到家最早也得快七点了吧？这做完饭再收拾收拾，第二天还得早起，你一天也不用做别的了，除了坐车就是做饭。
高梅丽是怎么也看不上李家的人，又接着说：还有，你们家李巍单位离家那么近，怎么就不能做做饭啊！依我说你和李巍分好工，周一到周五他做，周末和节假日你做，这样才合理。
其实夏真钰也真的很为难，等她下班到家做饭，吃完都得快九点，再说自己忙了一天，更别说还经常不能按时下班了。
对了，你结婚这么长时间了，我还没问你新婚之夜过得怎么样啊？给姐姐讲讲，哈哈！高梅丽笑得一脸暧昧。
夏真钰现在就怕别人提这事儿，就是开玩笑她自己都觉得心虚，赶紧打住这个话题说道：能不能聊点别的啊，打听这事儿做什么，你好歹也是个已婚妇女，新婚之夜什么样儿还问我，回家问你老公去。
content_en:
Song Juan said as if she had just discovered this problem now: Oh, I really didn't expect this. You are also much fatter than Lulu, so you probably can't wear it. I will take it back later to see if my colleague's girl can wear it.
She quickly wrapped up the clothes on the floor again. Seeing that Li Wei had almost eaten, she asked Li Wei to help her take them home. Li Wei and his mother went out. Xia Zhenyu cleaned all the dishes on the coffee table, put Western food and red wine on the dining table, played some piano music, and waited for Li Wei to come back.
When Li Wei came back, he was a little stunned when he saw the situation arranged by Xia Zhenyu. He thought about it and asked: Zhenyu, what are you doing? Is today a special day? Why didn't you tell me earlier? I just had dinner.
Xia Zhenyu motioned to Li Wei to sit opposite him and said with a smile: Just eat with me. I haven't eaten yet. These are specially ordered. It's not a special day. But I think it's been almost a month since we got married. Even when we were in love, we didn't have any romantic scenes. Thinking about it, we really need to come here once in a while to have fun.
Li Wei also smiled and said, "Yeah, it's all my fault. I never thought of this. It's too inconsiderate."
The two of them ate in silence to the soothing music. Xia Zhenyu finally decided to mention the problems they had been having these days: Li Wei, I actually want to talk about things between us today. I have never been able to find a suitable time before.
Before Xia Zhenyu could say anything further, Li Wei had already spoken hastily: Zhenyu, I know that I have neglected you these days. I didn't mean it, I just felt sorry for you.
Xia Zhenyu said gently: Why do you feel sorry for me?
Li Wei said: We have been married for so long and we haven't become a real couple yet. I know it's my fault. I'm under a lot of pressure. I don't know what's going on with me. I'm really afraid that there's something wrong with my body. What should I do? I'm also afraid that you will blame me and look down on me.
Finally, the crux was revealed. Xia Zhenyu thought that Li Wei had the same reason. It was mainly a man's self-esteem problem. Since he was willing to talk about it, it would be easy to solve, so he said: Li Wei, we are husband and wife. We have to face any difficulties together. In fact, I am also stressed. I am quite scared now because I failed to get things done several times.
Are you afraid too? Why? Li Wei wondered why Xia Zhenyu was afraid.
Xia Zhenyu looked at Li Wei helplessly: Of course I'm scared. It hurts me even if you try so many times. It's very uncomfortable.
Ah, I didn't expect that, yes, you are in pain every time. Zhenyu, if we could communicate earlier, these days wouldn't be so sad. Give me some time to debug, and if it still doesn't work, I, I'll go to the hospital. Li Wei had to make a lot of determination before he could go to the hospital.
Xia Zhenyu said with some emotion: "Okay, let's overcome the difficulties together. In fact, it doesn't necessarily have to be a physical problem. I checked some information online. There are many reasons that are psychological. Relax, don't think that I will have ideas, I will only support you." If you really go to the hospital, I will accompany you.
After the conversation, the relationship between the two became much more harmonious. After going to bed at night, Xia Zhenyu and Li Wei held hands and chatted under the quilt again. They chatted until it was slightly light before closing their eyes and falling asleep for a while. Within a few hours, they got up again and got ready to go to work. Although they didn't get enough sleep, they were in a good mood. Xia Zhenyu lost a big stone on his chest.
As soon as she arrived at the unit, Sister Wang came over and said to Xia Zhenyu while suppressing a smile: Zhenyu, do you have to treat me?
Judging from Sister Wang's expression, something good must have happened: Sister Wang, are you so happy, are you getting any benefits? Even if you want to treat me, you have to treat me. Can I be better than you?
Fool, you don’t know yet, Director Zhu will ask you contract workers to go up and sign the contract later.
Xia Zhenyu was confused: Signing a contract? What kind of contract are you signing? The contract has not expired yet.
Sister Wang chuckled and said: You are also lucky. Mayor Zhou was fine after receiving him once.He raised his salary.
Sister Wang, why do I become more confused the more you talk about it? Please talk to me carefully and don't always make jokes.
Sister Wang stopped teasing her and said: There was an internal meeting a few days ago. I attended it on behalf of our section chief. Otherwise, I wouldn't have known about it. Director Guo said that after the last inspection, Mayor Zhou personally told the district chief that the salary of you contract workers was too low and should be improved. He also said that you performed well. So the district held a special meeting to discuss your remuneration, and finally decided to give you a salary increase based on 60% of the official establishment! Tell me, should you treat me?
This is really a huge pie. The salary increase is not just a little bit. It has increased by thousands in one go, and it will increase with the official salary in the future. Zhou Jinyu is really a lucky star. God bless such a leader to have a prosperous official career. Xia Zhenyu silently blessed Zhou Jinyu in his heart.
Sure enough, after a while, the section chief asked her and several other contractors to go upstairs to find the office director. After entering Director Zhu's office, Director Zhu asked them all to sit down and said: You may have heard why I came to you. You have to thank your superiors for their care for you. You will have to work harder in the future to live up to the expectations of the organization.
Everyone nodded to express their determination. Director Zhu spoke for a while and then asked everyone to sign the new contract. Once signed, it would last for three years. Everyone was beaming with joy.
At this time, Director Zhu joked again: Actually, the person you should be most grateful to is Xiaoxia. Without her telling the truth to Mayor Zhou, would you be where you are today?
Xia Zhenyu really didn't know what to say. She was just telling the truth about Zhou Jinyu's problem. She didn't expect that the leader would actually do something practical. After listening to Director Zhu's words, the others also joked and thanked Xia Zhenyu, which made Xia Zhenyu very embarrassed.
After a while of fussing, everyone came out for fear of disturbing Director Zhu's work. Director Zhu left Xia Zhenyu alone and poured her another cup of tea. Xia Zhenyu was flattered. Director Zhu had never been so kind to non-staff members like them.
Director Zhu sat back behind his desk again, narrowed his eyes and said kindly to Xia Zhenyu: Xiaoxia, you performed well during the last inspection. Your superiors were very satisfied and had a good impression of you.
From the moment he walked in, Director Zhu kept mentioning his performance that day. Xia Zhenyu really didn't know what was good about him.
Director Zhu added: Xiaoxia, although I don’t usually communicate with you very much, I have always cared about you very much. Now I tell you as a big brother, no one else knows about this, and I wouldn’t have known about it if Director Guo didn’t ask me to accompany him later. This is what the district chief said.
Director Zhu thought for a while and then said: I heard what the district chief meant was that Mayor Zhou was originally very unhappy that day, but after communicating with the computer demonstrator, Mayor Zhou felt better again, so he didn't pursue the matter. The district chief also said that Mayor Zhou praised the demonstrator a few words, and then brought up the issue of treatment.
Xia Zhenyu felt that he was lucky, otherwise how could he have been praised by Zhou Jinyu, and he had made a fool of himself that day.
Director Zhu lowered his voice a little lower: After Director Guo came back, he felt that you were the lucky star of our unit. If Mayor Zhou really pursued the matter that day, it would be a big deal, so he thought about how the digital municipal government project is also a long-term job. You often go to the city to report work, so I wanted to change your current job.
Director Zhu, thank you all the leaders for your love for me. I will completely obey the arrangements in every job I am in. However, it is a bit far-fetched to say that I have won the favor of Mayor Zhou. I am afraid that if something happens in the future...
Don't worry, I understand what you mean. Don't worry, it's just that. Who can take it seriously?The new job assigned to you is to change departments and go directly to the Engineering Technology Section of the Information Center. You don’t have to do anything, just do some back-office reporting and other work, but you must understand and become familiar with the entire project as soon as possible. You will follow Director Guo when he makes a report.
Walking out of Director Zhu's office, Xia Zhenyu felt a little elated. After Director Zhu just talked about her new job, he also said that all benefits except salary would be provided to her in the future.
However, she was also a little worried. Everyone thought that she had escaped disaster because she made Mayor Zhou happy. In fact, she knew how that was possible. Maybe Zhou Jinyu didn't want to go on a killing spree. If something happened in the future, she might be beaten back to her original form.
After feeling worried for a while, I thought about it again. What are you afraid of? Anyway, it was the superiors who said good or bad, and I didn’t take any credit. The worst I could get was a 60% remuneration. It was already much better. I might as well give Gao Meili a call to celebrate.
The author has something to say: I just saw someone
PS: I didn’t even save the manuscript. I posted it directly after coding. It is inevitable that there will be some inappropriate things, and everyone must point them out.
It is estimated that Zhou Jinyu will play opposite Xia Zhenyu in the next chapter, but I can't be sure.
☆、Meet Zhou Jinyu again
Okay, I have you, Xia Zhenyu! This time, the fish jumped over the dragon's gate. While eating the seafood buffet, Gao Meili smiled brightly. This time Zhenyu finally got through it.
Don't talk nonsense, this is still a contract system. Although Xia Zhenyu said this, he couldn't hide the smile on his lips.
Come on, you are still pretending in front of me. It doesn’t matter what kind of organization he is, as long as he has a lot of money. Your mother-in-law is going to look down on you this time. You earn as much as their Li Wei now.
After we got married, she was still nice to me and there was nothing difficult about me, but I had to take some time to learn to cook. Xia Zhenyu discussed the matter, and Song Juan was okay with her. Except that she had some thoughts about her not learning to cook, everything else was passable.
I agree with learning to cook, and this is what you should do, but do you have time to do it? You get off work at five o'clock. From walking to the station to squeezing the bus, the earliest you can get home is almost seven o'clock, right? After you finish cooking, you clean up, and you have to get up early the next day. You don't have to do anything else all day long, except riding in the car and cooking.
Gao Meili couldn't look down on the Li family, so she went on to say: Also, your Li Wei's workplace is so close to home, so why can't you cook? According to me, it is reasonable for you and Li Wei to divide the work, he will do it from Monday to Friday, and you will do it on weekends and holidays.
In fact, Xia Zhenyu was really in trouble. When she got home from get off work to cook, it would be almost nine o'clock to finish her meal. Besides, she had been busy all day, not to mention that she often couldn't get off work on time.
By the way, you've been married for such a long time, and I haven't asked you how your wedding night was? Tell your sister, haha! Gao Meili smiled ambiguously.
Xia Zhenyu is now afraid that others will mention this matter. Even if she is joking, she feels guilty. She quickly stops the topic and says: Can we talk about something else? What are you asking about this matter? You are also a married woman after all. If you still ask me about my wedding night, go home and ask your husband.
